title: The paper skeleton
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The laundromat owner asks him to draw something for the window. He draws the paper skeleton, exactly, next to the paper skeleton. She hangs it. Two skeletons.

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner pointing at the window: the paper skeleton, jointed, taped up. WOOD.

balloons.text: Draw me something for the window.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner pointing at a jointed paper skeleton taped in the front window while a young man looks on, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood drawing the skeleton. Exactly. Every joint. On the back of a digest cover.

image.prompt: close on a young man's pen drawing a jointed paper skeleton exactly on the back of a photocopied sheet, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The drawing taped up beside the skeleton. Two skeletons, one paper, one ink.

image.prompt: a laundromat window with a paper skeleton taped beside an ink drawing of the same skeleton, black and white, no words

panels.composition: From the sidewalk: the window, the two skeletons, the owner behind the glass with her arms folded, satisfied. Wood already walking off.

image.prompt: a laundromat window from the sidewalk with two skeletons in it and a satisfied owner behind the glass, a young man walking away, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox
